paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents training time in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250,000, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents loss, with a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. The plot features two lines: a purple line with triangular markers representing the Vanilla model, and a red line with circular markers representing the SepLLM model. The purple line starts at approximately 2.72 and decreases to around 2.49, with a steady decline across the x-axis, while the red line starts at approximately 2.71 and decreases to around 2.46, also exhibiting a steady decline.
